platform: Linux with SO_COOKIE, MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC, boot ID and actual time-namespace descriptor support; unavailable observations refuse
claim_ceiling: one locally captured original accepted descriptor and its unchanged same-boot, same-time-namespace monotonic budget; no installed service, live executable attestation, semantic principal or native runtime authority

control.authentication: actual SO_PEERCRED checked against explicit PeerPolicy; descriptor packets require actual SCM_CREDENTIALS equal to original control peer
control.initial_challenge_authentication: original checked SO_PEERCRED; challenge may precede per-message credential delivery at sender endpoint
control.sequence: strictly increasing from 1, checked addition, no replay or resynchronization
control.duplicate_original_cookie: refuse even under a fresh sequence
control.fork_authority: creator PID checked before control use; child descriptor teardown never calls shutdown

original_descriptor.required_local_path: trusted absolute exact configured pathname; maximum 107 bytes, no abstract socket or noncanonical spelling
original_descriptor.received_fd_owner: immediate OwnedFd for all delivered SCM_RIGHTS and nonnegative kernel SCM_PIDFD descriptors under MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC; pidfd always refuses, never authorizes; parse all remaining ancillary rights and close each delivered descriptor once; kernel closes rights excluded by ancillary truncation
original_descriptor.sender_success: one packet enqueue only; no admission/action/durable acknowledgment

deadline.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC in matching actual Linux time namespace
deadline.starts_at: first AcceptedStreamCustody::capture ownership point, before descriptor admission checks
deadline.receiver_conversion: sample Instant first then actual monotonic clock; original absolute deadline fixed thereafter
deadline.future_product_consumer: AcceptedProductConnection::from_received consumes the supplied absolute Instant; admission, clone/setup and later queue/AgentPort checks never restart it

public_api.ReceivedAcceptedStream::consume_before: (self, impl FnOnce(UnixStream, Instant) -> T) -> Result<T, HandoffError>

ownership.consumer: one explicit FnOnce receives original stream and fixed deadline together; trusted Rust caller is not sandboxed
ownership.failure: consumes local custody and permanently retires this control instance; never returns a socket for retry
ownership.scope: this owned custody and control lifetime, not a global persistent ban on duplicate FDs across arbitrary trusted callers/channels

product_consumer.platform: Linux; existing raw attest remains available on its prior platform graph

admission.original_peer: SO_PEERCRED from transferred original UnixStream, never caller JSON
admission.attestor: existing ProcfsPeerAttestor and explicit PeerRuntimePolicy supplied by trusted Rust caller; normal live profile observes actual /proc executable, start/cgroup/unit and retains pidfd
admission.shared_private_helper: attest_before; raw attest preserves its Duration API and begins budget at original raw admission
admission.late_attestation_result: refuse and close owned stream/clone; original ceiling never renews
admission.handoff_error: DeadlineExceeded remains deadline refusal; other custody errors redact to PeerRefused
admission.deadline_observation: creator PID, cancellation and expiry rechecked before returning same stored Instant; no identity/dispatch authority
